name: Defence Industrial Strategy
issuer: Government of Canada (Department of National Defence)
relevance: Names Training and simulation as one of ten sovereign capabilities.

name: Industrial and Technological Benefits Policy: Key Industrial Capabilities
issuer: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
relevance: Training and Simulation is one of 17 Key Industrial Capabilities.

name: DAOD 2010-0, Modelling and Simulation
issuer: Department of National Defence / Canadian Armed Forces
relevance: Parent policy for defence modelling and simulation.

name: DAOD 2010-1, Modelling and Simulation Management
issuer: Department of National Defence / Canadian Armed Forces
relevance: Establishes the Synthetic Environment Coordination Office as the M&S coordination office.

name: Royal College accreditation of simulation programs
issuer: Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada
relevance: Stand-alone simulation program accreditation is being retired; expectations move into postgraduate and CPD accreditation.

name: Red Seal Program
relevance: Interprovincial trade credential; portability mechanism for skilled trades.

name: DHA Medical Modernization and Simulation Division and Defense Medical Modeling and Simulation Office
relevance: Single named office for military medical modelling and simulation; comparator for Canada.

name: Committee on Tactical Combat Casualty Care
issuer: Joint Trauma System, Defense Health Agency
relevance: Sets trauma care guidelines for the tactical environment.

name: Canadian Space Launch Act (Bill C-28)
relevance: Would create a launch and re-entry licensing regime with safety requirements and compliance tools. Personnel-qualification rules not yet public.

name: Authorization to launch uncrewed orbital and suborbital rockets
relevance: Interim authorization regime for launches in Canada; requires flight safety and ground hazard analysis.

name: 14 CFR 450.149 Safety-critical personnel qualifications
relevance: Requires training, qualification and current training for safety-critical personnel, and a process to track currency. Interval set by the operator.
notes: Foreign comparator, not a Canadian obligation.

name: 14 CFR 417.105 Launch personnel qualifications
relevance: Legacy regime requiring an annual personnel qualifications review.
notes: Superseded by Part 450 for new licences.

name: High Power Rocketry certification, Levels 1 to 4
issuer: Canadian Association of Rocketry / Association Canadienne de Fuséologie
relevance: Individual certification ladder recognised for mentor eligibility in national student rocketry competition.

name: Range Safety Officer qualification
issuer: Canadian Association of Rocketry / Association Canadienne de Fuséologie
relevance: Peer-approved range safety qualification; requires knowledge of the rocket provisions of the Canadian Aviation Regulations.

name: Pyrotechnician and special effects pyrotechnician certificates
relevance: Certificates for handling regulated explosives; special effects pyrotechnician requires two years as a senior pyrotechnician.

name: NDT personnel certification (CAN/CGSB-48.9712, ISO 9712)
issuer: Natural Resources Canada NDT Certification Body; CWB Group
relevance: Three certification levels for non-destructive testing personnel, with annual vision checks.
notes: Second certifier: SRC-43. Maintenance deadline extended during the CGSB transition.

name: Space Systems Technician Certificate of Qualification
relevance: Provider-issued technician credential; provider states CCAA certification.
